subject: Programming and DS: Data Structures
name: Binary Heap
priorityEvidence: 30 PYQs extracted, tested 1990-2025. Sixth and final Data Structures topic in study order — reuses Binary Tree's array-representation pattern with a different invariant.

prerequisites.why: Heap array-representation formulas (parent/child index) are the same as complete binary tree array representation.

unlocks.why: Heap Sort is a direct application of build-heap + repeated extract-max.
Prim's algorithm uses a min-heap as its priority queue.
Dijkstra's shortest path also uses a min-heap priority queue.
